start_here: Say to your AI: "List the sending keys on my Resend account with their names and dates." It runs tool:list-sending-keys, which shows ids and names, never a key.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it reads the keys your email-sending account has and writes nothing.
instructions: 1. Connect your Resend account once so your key is held under the name resend-api-key; the key is never typed into the request.
2. Say to your AI: "List my Resend keys". It calls tools:run with tool tool:list-sending-keys and an empty input {}.
3. Read data: each key's id, name and created_at. A key itself is never shown (Resend shows it once, when made).
4. To turn one off, give its id to tool:remove-a-sending-key.

worked_examples.title: Two keys on the account
worked_examples.ask: List the sending keys on my Resend account.
worked_examples.given: Read from tools/email-sending-domains/tool-rows.json: the row sends GET https://api.resend.com/api-keys with your key in the Authorization header and returns Resend's reply unchanged (result_selector "$"); data items carry id, name, created_at per its output_schema. Ids and dates are synthetic.
